[NDET.1.3] **The guarantee covers libds as its own build makes it.** libds's
`Float` arithmetic is its own ([IARC.7.10]): the integrator's C
runtime, libm or SDK cannot replace it, and libds does not change the
integrator's floating point, rounding mode included ([LDET.3.6.1]).

tla.name: ndet_1_3__outer_untouched
tla.note: bounded: three modes, two engines, depth 6; a mode set in a callback is that callback's (LDET.3.6.1)
